_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Jukebox/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Jukebox/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-10-12: the phone app has no accounts at all (noAccounts in main.tsx), so no email, no user id and no signed-in usage events. The suite user count (install id) was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0, and the anonymous daily open count that replaced it is OFF in the phone and desktop apps (src/main.tsx `openCount: !isNativeShell() && !isDesktopApp()`), so no Device or other IDs, and no App interactions either. The music, its tags, art and lyrics never leave the device. The lookups (lrclib.net on Android only, opt-in; Wikipedia, opt-in; iTunes Search on tap) go straight from the phone to those services and are not collected by us. So: no data collected. Re-import this at the next Play release. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
